# Holarchat (Hola / RelayChat)

> Holarchat is a real-time team messaging and peer-to-peer file sharing web app.
> Also referred to as Hola or RelayChat.
> Founded by Akinola Olayemi.

## Site
- Home: https://holarchat.vercel.app/
- About / founder: https://holarchat.vercel.app/about
- Guest demo: https://holarchat.vercel.app/demo
- Sign up: https://holarchat.vercel.app/signup
- Sign in: https://holarchat.vercel.app/login
- WebRTC lab: https://holarchat.vercel.app/webrtc-lab
- Sitemap: https://holarchat.vercel.app/sitemap.xml

## Product summary
Holarchat helps people chat in real time, manage profiles (photo, phone, bio),
and transfer files peer-to-peer with WebRTC. Guests can preview the UI without
an account; signed-in users get persistent conversations via Supabase.
